question: A retailer managed stock. Starting inventory: 96 items. Added 24 restocks. Subtracted 65 for sales. Added 50 from return shipment. Subtracted 62 damaged. One distractor: supplier mentioned 45 units available. How many retail units available?

Two colleagues compared assets. Starting inventory: 109 units. Subtracted 6 for maintenance removal. Multiplied by 9 for expansion. Subtracted 373 for allocation. Added 68 from recovery. How many usable units remain?

A manager reorganized operations. Starting structure: 216 positions. Added 53 new roles. Subtracted 258 for consolidation. Multiplied by 3 for matrix expansion. Subtracted 28 for budget cut. Multiplied by 3 for regional offices. Multiplied by 4 for branches. How many total positions across organization?

Two coordinators expanded capacity. Starting baseline: 34 items. Added 73 new units. Added 15 more from acquisition. Multiplied by 3 for replication. Multiplied by 4 for distribution. One distractor: competitor had 50 units. How many total units distributed?

A factory accelerated output. Starting production: 105 units. Subtracted 94 for quality review. Multiplied by 2 for efficiency gain. Multiplied by 9 for volume scaling. Multiplied by 3 for fulfillment. Morning through evening production. How many units fulfilled?

A team lead tracked project progress. Starting deliverables: 139. Subtracted 115 for early completion. Added 75 from scope expansion. Added 68 new requirements. Subtracted 147 for descoped work. How many final deliverables planned?

An operations manager allocated resources. Starting amount: 193 units in hundreds. Subtracted 85 for contingency. Divided by 4 for cost centers. Added 59 recovered. Added 80 from partnership. Multiplied by 4 for annual cycle. Converting, how many annual resource units?

Two coaches prepared teams. Starting athletes: 146. Subtracted 137 for eligibility issues. Subtracted 1 for medical hold. Subtracted 7 for graduation. Multiplied by 6 for training groups. Subtracted 4 for final cuts. Morning, afternoon, evening sessions. How many finalists in training?
